title: The prime minister wants to build a stronger and faster clean economy. What’s holding it back? - The Hill Times
text:
Canada has a rare and powerful opportunity to dramatically scale up its clean industrial economy, create high-quality jobs, and attract global investment into markets where we already hold a competitive edge.
